cases.purpose: Rejected affinity fails before executing the command
cases.oracle: Upstream taskset in the same two-vCPU VM
cases.comparison: Compare status and diagnostic presence; verify the child did not run.
cases.script:
rm -f marker
taskset -c 5 /usr/bin/touch marker >out 2>err; rc=$?; [[ -s err ]] && d=yes || d=no; printf "status=%s diagnostic=%s\n" "$rc" "$d"; [[ ! -e marker ]] && echo child-not-run; rm -f marker out err
